residueAuditManifest.name: historicalRecords
residueAuditManifest.description: Immutable ledger of past committed transitions; verified non-authoritative for direct state mutation.
residueAuditManifest.runtimeProof: History is strictly append-only post-commit and validated during hydration without overriding CanonicalState directly.

residueAuditManifest.name: pendingCandidates
residueAuditManifest.description: Legacy candidate buffer completely replaced by VEIL PreAuth candidate list in server.ts.
residueAuditManifest.runtimeProof: Codebase search confirms pendingCandidates has 0 references in state, validator, and actionApplier.

residueAuditManifest.name: validationLogs
residueAuditManifest.description: Telemetry logs for diagnostics output; zero mutation authority.
residueAuditManifest.runtimeProof: Engine returns read-only validation verdict logs with no link to ActionApplier draft execution.

residueAuditManifest.name: diagnostics
residueAuditManifest.runtimeProof: getDiagnostics() constructs an isolated unlinked object; modifying it has zero impact on engine private fields.

residueAuditManifest.name: stateVersion
residueAuditManifest.description: Strict concurrency tracking counter enforced at Commit Gate.
residueAuditManifest.runtimeProof: Direct client-submitted stateVersion values are rejected if conflicting with engine private stateVersion.

residueAuditManifest.name: lastEventId
residueAuditManifest.description: Immutable record of last committed event identifier.
residueAuditManifest.runtimeProof: Used for historical continuity verification during hydration; cannot be forged to bypass ACL.

residueAuditManifest.name: turnTraces
residueAuditManifest.description: Deprecated debug trace array removed from engine core.
residueAuditManifest.runtimeProof: Zero usage in production engine runtime.

residueAuditManifest.name: checkpoints
residueAuditManifest.description: Deprecated rollback checkpoint mechanism replaced by pure dry-run working copy draft.
residueAuditManifest.runtimeProof: Rollbacks now use pure functional atomic draft state copy discard with zero persistent residue.

residueAuditManifest.name: saveDietEvents
residueAuditManifest.description: Obsolete memory compression flag removed from engine types.
residueAuditManifest.runtimeProof: Zero occurrences in active engine codebase.

residueAuditManifest.name: contextSnapshot
residueAuditManifest.description: Prompt context string returned in API responses for debugging.
residueAuditManifest.runtimeProof: Pure diagnostic response string; server.ts does not parse it back into CanonicalState.

residueAuditManifest.name: rawResponse
residueAuditManifest.description: Unparsed raw text output from Gemini API.
residueAuditManifest.runtimeProof: Treated as untrusted raw string; parsed through codeblock regex and EngineValidator before any commit.

residueAuditManifest.name: selectedCandidateId
residueAuditManifest.description: Integer ID parsed from LLM #2 response in Phase 2.
residueAuditManifest.runtimeProof: Strictly checked against server-side allowedCandidates whitelist in server.ts; fails closed if unapproved.

residueAuditManifest.name: isFallbackNonMutation
residueAuditManifest.description: Boolean flag indicating all candidates were rejected and non-mutation fallback was executed.
residueAuditManifest.runtimeProof: Server response flag only; does not mutate any canonical state.
